name: beholder
lore:
Deep within the suffocating darkness of the Underdark floats one of the multiverse's most terrifying aberrations: the beholder. A grotesque orb of pebbly, cool-toned flesh, this creature is defined by its massive, toothy maw and a singular, cyclopean central eye. Haloed by ten writhing eyestalks, the 'sphere of many eyes' drifts silently through the subterranean depths, driven by an intelligence so vast and alien that it views humanoid schemes as the mere fumbling of infants.

To cross paths with an eye tyrant is to step into a nightmare of absolute surveillance. With three hundred and sixty degrees of darkvision, a beholder cannot be ambushed or eluded. Its central gaze projects a nullifying cone of antimagic, rendering the mightiest spells useless, while its remaining eyestalks weave a deadly tapestry of disintegration, charm, and raw destructive power. They are solitary, xenophobic sovereigns who demand absolute subjugation from all other living things.
